analysis.session_summary: CHF and USD led the board while NZD, AUD and JPY lagged in a tape defined by Middle East supply headlines and a soft risk tone. Brent rallied 0.804%, the DXY rose 0.285%, the S&P fell 0.357% and VIX added 0.61%. Event reactions to Canada CPI and two Lagarde appearances were all muted, offering no new macro impulse. The main intraday catalyst was Trump's Iran-deal comment, which triggered partial reversals across dollar, oil and risk pairs late in the window.

themes.evidence: CHF strength 0.361%, USD strength 0.285%, VIX +0.61, SPX -0.357
Brent +0.804%; headline: Saudi oil pipeline hit in strikes will be mostly out of service for several weeks for repair
Canada CPI own-currency impulse 0.008%; ECB Lagarde 17:15 impulse -0.008%; ECB Lagarde 10:00 impulse 0.0%

leg_notes.EUR/USD: A steady overnight decline of -71.7 pips was partly retraced by a late 35.0-pip bounce on the Iran-deal headline, leaving the pair down 39.5 pips and mid-range at 0.48.
leg_notes.USD/JPY: The big 154.2-pip up leg between 23:15 and 15:45 had no clear catalyst, then Trump's Iran comment erased 59.7 pips; net +60.8 pips.
leg_notes.GBP/USD: Cable tracked EUR/USD lower before a late 37.7-pip rebound on the Iran-deal headline; net -17.8 pips.
leg_notes.USD/CHF: Despite a 36.6-pip up leg early, the pair closed at 0.05 of its range as CHF strength dominated; net -5.5 pips.
leg_notes.AUD/USD: Aussie fell for most of the window before a 34.2-pip late rebound; net -28.8 pips.
leg_notes.NZD/USD: Kiwi was the weakest major, down 29.2 pips net, with only a late 27.3-pip bounce.
leg_notes.USD/CAD: The pair gained 60.5 pips into 15:45 then gave back 22.2 pips late; net +39.3 pips and close 0.61 of range.
leg_notes.EUR/CHF: CHF strength drove a 46.5-pip down leg and a close at 0.07 of range; net -38.4 pips.
leg_notes.CHF/JPY: The cross surged 168.8 pips into 12:00, then Trump's comment reversed only 16.2 pips; net +87.2 pips.
leg_notes.AUD/NZD: Choppy but net +12.5 pips with close 0.76 of range; no clear trend.
leg_notes.EUR/GBP: EUR weakened against GBP in a 22.0-pip down leg, then a small 3.8-pip Lagarde-driven bounce; net -17.8 pips.
leg_notes.AUD/CHF: CHF strength drove a 35.0-pip down leg, partly retraced late; net -27.5 pips.
leg_notes.NZD/CHF: CHF strength dominated with a 41.3-pip down leg; net -26.8 pips.
